Title: Application for Admission of a Child to a Preschool/Daycare, Ministry of Education, Commonwealth of Dominica
Kind: school registration; derived value (date of birth split into date, month, year)
Source: https://www.education.gov.dm/images/documents/parents/Application%20for%20Admission%20of%20a%20Child%20to%20a%20Preschool.pdf
Fetched: 2026-11-24 (file dated 2015-03-01)
Notes: Pages 1-2. Later pages (health and other details) are left out. On page 1 the child's details sit inside a box headed "FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY", as printed. The coat of arms and the photo box are left out. [Bnn] ids are added for scoring.
